lessons_used: Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint changes showed no clear effect across all 4 tests.
Home wait info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Adoption layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish redesign, home notification, home redesign, sign_in copy, sign_in redesign, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Desktop companion quick controls new screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen following home intro that outlines essential desktop pet interactions and control shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support messages show confusion about how to control or interact with pets after setup, and finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.

new_pet_controls.headline: Desktop Companion Quick Controls
new_pet_controls.body: Discover how to summon, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet effortlessly.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new controls screen following home intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off and support issues at finish step, but requires new screen release.

candidates.title: Sign in layout account recovery focus redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen using a list layout focused on account restoration and pet inventory synchronization.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing or reset after signing back in, and sign-in exhibits high mean completion times.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Pets
sign_in.body: Ensure your desktop pet data is safely synced to your cloud account.

guard.reason: Redesign of the sign-in screen maintaining its functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong support signal with moderate historic lift (+1.8%) on sign-in redesigns.

candidates.title: Desktop setup status preview new flow
candidates.change: Insert a desktop environment setup status checklist screen during the waiting sequence.
candidates.why: Waiting and home phases take substantial time (mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop.

new_setup_status.headline: Preparing Desktop Environment
new_setup_status.body: Verifying screen display permissions and pet animation renderer.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a setup status screen during the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Home new flow is a proven pattern (won 2/3 tests, +3.5%) addressing long wait times.

candidates.title: Pick friend split layout feature showcase redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection step with a split layout to showcase companion traits alongside choices.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences a high mean duration of 1017s and drop-off to 68.5%.

pick_friend.headline: Select Your Ideal Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Compare companion behaviors and choose the pet that suits your desktop background.

guard.reason: Redesign of the pet selection screen while keeping core functionality intact.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops many users, but adoption redesign historically yields negative lift (-2.3%).

candidates.title: Clear path selection intent copy update
candidates.change: Update headline and body on the path choice screen to provide direct contrast between preset adoption and photo creation.
candidates.why: Path selection mean duration is 514s, suggesting hesitation over option differences.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Get Your Desktop Pet?
choose_path.body: Adopt a ready-to-play companion or build a custom pet using your own photos.

guard.reason: Copy update clearly offering options to adopt or create a custom pet.

candidates.score_note: Cheap copy update targeting path hesitation, weak prior evidence (+2.3%).

candidates.title: Home intro checklist layout finish step
candidates.change: Switch home intro layout to a checklist style highlighting setup completion milestones.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with long median and mean completion times.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready to Launch
home_intro.body: Review your pet setup summary and spawn your companion on screen.

guard.reason: Layout update to home intro within allowed onboarding changes.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but finish step modifications consistently underperform.

candidates.title: Companion rendering tips waiting screen info
candidates.change: Display practical advice on waiting screen regarding desktop pet placement while rendering completes.
candidates.why: Home waiting median is 201s (mean 2336s), making active guidance during generation crucial.

waiting.hint: Tip: Once ready, your pet can freely wander your desktop or stay anchored to active windows.

guard.reason: Valid addition of waiting screen tip information.

candidates.score_note: Low cost, but home wait info updates showed negligible effect in prior tests (+0.5%).

candidates.title: Custom photo upload formatting hint
candidates.change: Add photo quality and framing guidance hints on the upload photos screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted companion appearances.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit photos focused on your pet for optimal 3D generation accuracy.

guard.reason: Valid photo upload guidance hint added to upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support tickets directly with low-cost formatting hint configuration.

candidates.title: Account pet sync confirmation notification
candidates.change: Enable ready notification flag on sign-in screen to confirm account sync status.
candidates.why: Multiple users reported missing pets after re-authenticating, creating anxiety during sign in.

sign_in.hint: Your pet collection and setup progress will automatically back up to your account.

guard.reason: Valid configuration update to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Config flag addresses sync anxiety, though notification changes show limited historical gains.

candidates.title: Story screen starter companion bonus incentive
candidates.change: Add an incentive badge on the story screen highlighting starter companion perks.
candidates.why: Improving initial motivation helps lift overall onboarding funnel conversion from 24.6%.

guard.reason: Mentions 'Free' extras in onboarding copy, violating rule 3.
